descriptionPlain:
At Anchorage Digital, we are building the world’s most advanced digital asset platform for institutions to participate in crypto.
 
Anchorage Digital is a crypto platform that enables institutions to participate in digital assets through custody, staking, trading, governance, settlement, and the industry's leading security infrastructure. Home to Anchorage Digital Bank N.A., the first federally chartered crypto bank in the U.S., Anchorage Digital also serves institutions through Anchorage Digital Singapore, Porto by Anchorage Digital, and other offerings.
 
The company is funded by leading institutions including Andreessen Horowitz, GIC, Goldman Sachs, KKR, and Visa, with its Series D valuation over $3 billion. Founded in 2017 in San Francisco, California, Anchorage Digital has offices in New York, New York; Porto, Portugal; Singapore; and Sioux Falls, South Dakota. Learn more at anchorage.com, on X @Anchorage, and on LinkedIn. 
With the evolving landscape of digital threats and an increasing volume of sophisticated attacks by malicious actors, we have a security policy mandating all new hires complete an in-person onboarding process - no exceptions. Security is our foundation and we prioritize physical identity verification and secure IT setup. While our security and IT logistics require physical presence to protect our infrastructure from sophisticated global threats, this move is equally about our Village culture. We believe that a laptop can be shipped, but our culture cannot.


We are seeking a senior business development leader to spearhead our go-to-market strategy for stablecoin issuance and banking solutions within APAC, focusing on originating strategic partnerships with leading banks and enterprises. The ideal candidate will leverage deep expertise in Foreign Exchange (FX), institutional lending, or correspondent banking to demonstrate how our platform can revolutionize treasury operations, FX settlement, and inter-bank transactions. In this role, you will be responsible for the entire deal lifecycle, cultivating C-level relationships and structuring complex commercial agreements, while serving as a trusted advisor on digital asset implementation. Crucially, you will act as the primary driver of our stablecoin business regional growth, gathering critical market intelligence to directly inform our global product roadmap and leveraging your extensive network within APAC's financial sector to close landmark deals.
 
We have created the Factors of Growth & Impact to help Villagers better measure impact and articulate coaching, feedback, and the rich and rewarding learning that happens while exploring, developing, and mastering the capabilities and contributions within and outside of the APAC Regional Lead, Stablecoin Solutions role:

We are seeking a senior business development leader to spearhead our go-to-market strategy for stablecoin issuance and banking solutions within APAC, focusing on originating strategic partnerships with leading banks and enterprises. The ideal candidate will leverage deep expertise in Foreign Exchange (FX), institutional lending, or correspondent banking to demonstrate how our platform can revolutionize treasury operations, FX settlement, and inter-bank transactions. In this role, you will be responsible for the entire deal lifecycle, cultivating C-level relationships and structuring complex commercial agreements, while serving as a trusted advisor on digital asset implementation. Crucially, you will act as the primary driver of our stablecoin business regional growth, gathering critical market intelligence to directly inform our global product roadmap and leveraging your extensive network within APAC's financial sector to close landmark deals.
 
We have created the Factors of Growth & Impact to help Villagers better measure impact and articulate coaching, feedback, and the rich and rewarding learning that happens while exploring, developing, and mastering the capabilities and contributions within and outside of the APAC Regional Lead, Stablecoin Solutions role:

lists.text: What You'll Do:
lists.content:
• Members of the stablecoins team at Anchorage Digital are integral to driving forward our growth and success in the digital currency space by originating high-value client relationships and monetizing the company’s stablecoin products and services.
  • Members of the stablecoin team are expected to be ambassadors for our stablecoin solutions, building Anchorage Digital’s reputation as a trusted partner for issuance and integration.
  • You will be a critical source of client insights and market intelligence on stablecoin use cases, helping inform our product road map and business plan.

lists.text: You may be a fit for this role if you have:
lists.content:
• Strong technical knowledge of how blockchain and digital assets can be applied to solve real-world inter-bank challenges, including an understanding of fund flows, settlement mechanics, correspondent banking and cross-border payment flows.
  • A strong network of contacts within the global banking and financial enterprise ecosystem in APAC, specifically with decision-makers.
  • Acquaintance with existing and potential stablecoin issuers in your region. Familiarity with the regulatory landscape and main actors.
  • 10+ years of experience managing the entire institutional client engagement process, including sourcing opportunities, structuring complex payment and settlement deals, navigating to completion, and ensuring a successful onboarding experience.
  • Enjoy working in a fast paced, start up environment.
  • Excellent communication skills and sales acumen.
  • The primary focus of this position is on direct sales and revenue generation, rather than partnership management.

lists.text: Although not a requirement, bonus points if:
lists.content:
• Deep expertise in the global payments ecosystem, including correspondent banking models and enterprise business structures, with a specific focus on the regional market and its unique regulatory landscape (e.g., SEPA, PSD2) and payment rails.
  • Professional fluency in a relevant regional language is highly preferred.
  • You were emotionally moved by the soundtrack to Hamilton, which chronicles the founding of a new financial system. :)

Anchorage Digital is looking for a highly motivated and experienced Credit Trader to drive revenue growth and institutional adoption of our Prime Financing platform. Our Prime Financing business is a high-growth business line within the Global Markets franchise, specializing in originating structured lending and credit solutions that solve capital constraints for the world's leading crypto-native and TradFi institutions.
 
In this role, you will be responsible for structuring, pricing, and managing bespoke credit facilities, including margin lending, delayed settlement tradins, and collateralized loan agreements using BTC, ETH, and other digital assets. You will work closely with our sales and risk teams to convert our pipeline, manage credit exposure, and deliver capital-efficient financing solutions. This role requires strong attention to detail, creativity, sense of risk management, and a team-player mindset.

Anchorage Digital is looking for a highly motivated and experienced Credit Trader to drive revenue growth and institutional adoption of our Prime Financing platform. Our Prime Financing business is a high-growth business line within the Global Markets franchise, specializing in originating structured lending and credit solutions that solve capital constraints for the world's leading crypto-native and TradFi institutions.
 
In this role, you will be responsible for structuring, pricing, and managing bespoke credit facilities, including margin lending, delayed settlement tradins, and collateralized loan agreements using BTC, ETH, and other digital assets. You will work closely with our sales and risk teams to convert our pipeline, manage credit exposure, and deliver capital-efficient financing solutions. This role requires strong attention to detail, creativity, sense of risk management, and a team-player mindset.

lists.text: As a Credit Trader you will:
lists.content:
• Execute a variety of credit structures, from credit agreements to control agreements.
  • Develop new credit structures, agreements, and documentation as the loan portfolio mix changes.
  • Take a solutions-based approach to originating solutions to client needs and drive revenue growth in diverse market conditions
  • Negotiate, prepare, and close all legal contracts within the lending business.
  • Collaborate cross-functionally to qualify and structure credit opportunities to scale our lending business.
  • Move and track collateral across multiple venues and business lines in order to optimize utilization, yield and funding
  • Create detailed memos and runbooks on operationalization of current as well future funding facilities across CeFi and DeFi
  • Originate and manage key external funding partner relationships
  • Regularly analyze risks levels and market trends to identify areas of optimization and lead improvements

lists.text: You may be a fit for this role if you have:
lists.content:
• 6+ years of experience in credit trading and/or financial products structuring. Experience at a tier 1 investment bank strongly preferred.
  • Deep knowledge of crypto markets, especially as relates to financing. Experience with lending or related role at a top crypto platform strongly preferred.
  • Experience structuring and developing complex financial products with large institutions as well as startups.
  • Strong familiarity with legal and regulatory requirements for US financial products.
  • Experience building strong cross-functional partnerships with legal, operations, compliance, sales and business teams.
  • A highly collaborative, team player mindset
  • An entrepreneurial drive, with the creativity and initiative to deliver solutions to client demand and generate revenue.
  • Strong risk management acumen and experience developing processes and control frameworks to ensure sustainable, risk-managed growth.
  • A detail-oriented and highly organized method of working
  • Excellent analytical and communication skills

lists.text: Although not a requirement, bonus points if:
lists.content:
• Ability to write scripts (e.g., Bash scripts, Python scripts) to automate manual processes and familiarity with Python for data manipulation and analysis
  • You have a law degree and/or an advanced degree in Financial Engineering (or a related quantitative discipline).
  • You’ve kept up to date with crypto derivatives strategies and defi ecosystem

Anchorage Digital is a crypto platform that enables institutions to participate in digital assets through custody, staking, trading, governance, settlement, and the industry's leading security infrastructure. Home to Anchorage Digital Bank N.A., the first federally chartered crypto bank in the U.S., Anchorage Digital also serves institutions through Anchorage Digital Singapore, Porto by Anchorage Digital, and other offerings.
 
The company is funded by leading institutions including Andreessen Horowitz, GIC, Goldman Sachs, KKR, and Visa, with its Series D valuation over $3 billion. Founded in 2017 in San Francisco, California, Anchorage Digital has offices in New York, New York; Porto, Portugal; Singapore; and Sioux Falls, South Dakota. Learn more at anchorage.com, on X @Anchorage, and on LinkedIn. 

With the evolving landscape of digital threats and an increasing volume of sophisticated attacks by malicious actors, we have a security policy mandating all new hires complete an in-person onboarding process - no exceptions. Security is our foundation and we prioritize physical identity verification and secure IT setup. While our security and IT logistics require physical presence to protect our infrastructure from sophisticated global threats, this move is equally about our Village culture. We believe that a laptop can be shipped, but our culture cannot.


We are seeking a mid-level derivatives trader to help us build and scale our OTC Derivatives Trading business. If you have a strong foundation in derivatives trading, are passionate about crypto and trading, and thrive in a collaborative, high-energy environment, we want to hear from you.

lists.text: Responsibilities:
lists.content:
• As Trader of OTC Derivatives at Anchorage, you will bring your expertise in trading derivatives (including options, forwards, and structured products) across digital and traditional asset classes to help build and scale a best-in-class trading platform. You will play a key role in executing client business, managing risk, and developing the derivatives trading franchise.

    • In this position, you will:

  • Develop, execute, and manage trading strategies for digital asset derivatives.
  • Drive P&L growth while maintaining disciplined risk management practices.
  • Build and refine trading infrastructure, develop new models, and create durable processes to support the growth and success of our derivatives business.
  • Coordinate closely with team members across the globe to deliver seamless market operations
  • Collaborate with engineering and quant teams to build and enhance trading infrastructure and improve execution quality and risk management systems
  • Provide market color and insights to internal stakeholders and help produce client-facing content.

lists.text: Must Haves:
lists.content:
• Experience: 3-5 years of experience in trading derivatives including options, forwards, and structured products. Prior sell-side derivatives trading experience at a bank and professional crypto experience are highly valued.
  • Market Knowledge: Possess strong fundamentals in derivatives pricing, risk management, and market structure.
  • Quantitative Skills: Strong quantitative and analytical capabilities, coding skills, and excellent attention to detail. Experience with quantitative modeling and data analysis using Python, R or other languages. Experience working with complex financial models, interpreting datasets, and deriving actionable insights to drive trading decisions.
  • Communication Skills: Strong written and verbal communication skills.
  • Culture: Strong attention to detail and disciplined approach to risk management. Intellectual curiosity and a strong desire to learn crypto markets. Ability to operate in a fast-paced, high feedback trading environment. A collaborative team player who demonstrates high levels of ownership in their responsibilities.

lists.text: Although not a requirement, bonus points if:
lists.content: You were emotionally moved by the soundtrack to Hamilton, which chronicles the founding of a new financial system. :)You were emotionally moved by the soundtrack to Hamilton, which chronicles the founding of a new financial system. :)

About Anchorage Digital: Who we are
 
The Anchorage Village, what we call our team, brings together the brightest minds from platform security, financial services, and distributed ledger technology to provide the building blocks that empower institutions to safely participate in  the evolving digital asset ecosystem. As a diverse team of more than 600 members, we are united in one common goal: building the future of finance by providing the foundation upon which value moves safely in the new global economy. 
 
Anchorage Digital is committed to being a welcoming and inclusive workplace for everyone, and we are intentional about making sure people feel respected, supported, and connected at work—regardless of who you are or where you come from. We value and celebrate our differences and we believe being open about who we are allows us to do the best work of our lives.
 
Anchorage Digital is an Equal Opportunity Employer. We are committed to equal employment opportunity regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, gender identity or veteran status. Anchorage Digital considers qualified applicants regardless of criminal histories, consistent with other legal requirements. “Anchorage Digital” refers to services that are offered either through Anchorage Digital Bank National Association, an OCC-chartered national trust bank, or Anchorage Lending CA, LLC a finance lender licensed by the California Department of Financial Protection and Innovation, License No. 60DBO-11976, or Anchorage Digital Singapore Pte Ltd, a Singapore private limited company, all wholly-owned subsidiaries of Anchor Labs, Inc., a Delaware corporation.
 
Protecting your privacy rights is important to Anchorage Digital, and we work to maintain the trust and confidence of our clients when handling personal or financial information. Please see our privacy policy notices here.

lists.content:
• Drive incremental trading volume market share gains for the Global Markets business for crypto native firms such as protocols, VC’s and other buy side firms.
  • Be the first point of contact for all things global markets to multiple client segments.  You will solve their needs quickly by leveraging your internal relationships. 
  • Establish sales methodologies and sales operational processes to improve offensive go-to-market posture.

lists.text: Complexity and Impact of Work:
lists.content:
• Help inform the targeted go to market strategy including marketing, to business operations and client experience.
  • Lead client or product specific campaigns or projects that will drive new business and enhance the Anchorage Digital offering.  These can be market insights, curated content for certain client segments, or teach-ins.

lists.text: Organizational Knowledge:

• Entrepreneurial attitude and intellectual curiosity. Ability to think creatively and help design solutions to client specific challenges.

  • Excellent communication skills, relationship management, and sales acumen.

We are looking for a hands-on, detail-oriented accounting professional to join our Regulated Trading & Derivatives accounting team. Working directly with the Global Accounting Lead (CFO), you will help run the books, close, and regulatory reporting for our Swap-dealer and Broker-dealer entities.

This is a builder role. Many of the processes, reconciliations, and controls you will use do not exist yet, and you will help design them. You will work at the intersection of digital asset trading and traditional market regulation (SEC, FINRA, CFTC, NFA), learning how regulatory capital and financial reporting work from the inside. If you like getting into the detail, finding what is broken, and fixing it, this role is for you.

lists.text: Accounting & Close
lists.content:
• Prepare journal entries, account reconciliations, and flux analysis for the Broker-dealer and Swap-dealer entities as part of the monthly, quarterly, and year-end close, in accordance with US GAAP.
  • Account for trading activity, derivatives, margin, collateral, and digital asset positions, and reconcile them to clearing, custody, and counterparty statements.
  • Investigate and resolve breaks and open items quickly, and document the root cause so they do not repeat.
  • Support internal and external auditors with schedules, samples, and walkthroughs.

lists.text: Regulatory Reporting
lists.content:
• Prepare the supporting schedules and workpapers behind SEC FOCUS reports, CFTC/NFA swap dealer financial reports (CFTC Regulation 23.105), and daily or monthly net capital computations.
  • Help monitor compliance with SEC Rule 15c3-1 (Net Capital) and SEC Rule 15c3-3 (Customer Protection) for the Broker-dealer, and with CFTC Regulation 23.101 (minimum capital) and 23.104 (equity withdrawal restrictions) for the Swap-dealer, and flag early-warning issues promptly.
  • Support the accounting and reconciliation of all derivatives trading activity for uncleared swaps, including initial and variation margin and collateral under the CFTC uncleared margin rules (CFTC Regulations 23.150–23.161).
  • Maintain the weekly regulatory capital model and prepare related internal updates.
  • Support regulatory audits and examinations (SEC, FINRA, CFTC, NFA): pull and tie out schedules, respond to document requests, and help track remediation items.

lists.text: Build & Improve
lists.content:
• Help set up the books, chart of accounts, reconciliations, close checklists, and reporting packages for the Swap-dealer and Broker-dealer entities, and contribute to planning if a futures commission merchant (FCM) is added later.
  • Document processes and help design and test internal controls over financial reporting (ICFR) suited to digital asset trading and derivatives.
  • Look for ways to automate manual work in spreadsheets and the ledgering system, and work with Treasury, Trading Operations, Engineering, and Product to get data flowing cleanly.
  • Partner with Compliance, Legal, and Trading to understand the accounting and regulatory effect of new products and trading strategies.
  • Take on special and ad-hoc projects as the team grows.

lists.text: You may be a fit for this role if you have:
lists.content:
• Experience: 8+ years of progressive accounting or finance experience, ideally in the finance team of a broker-dealer, swap dealer, FCM, bank, trading firm, or crypto company.
  • Education: Bachelor’s degree in Accounting, Finance, or a related field. CPA license or active progress toward one is strongly preferred.
  • Technical accounting: Solid command of US GAAP, including ASC 815 (Derivatives and Hedging) and accounting for trading securities, margin, collateral, and revenue recognition.
  • Trading and derivatives understanding: Exposure to derivatives such as futures, options, and uncleared swaps. You do not need to have run these books yourself, but you should understand how the trades flow into the ledger.
  • Regulatory awareness: Working familiarity with broker-dealer financial reporting (FOCUS, net capital, customer protection) and CFTC/NFA swap dealer requirements (capital, financial reporting, uncleared margin) is a strong plus. We will train you on the rest and support you in earning Series 27 and NFA Series 3 licenses over time.
  • Tools: Advanced Excel skills and comfort with a modern ledger or ERP (such as NetSuite) and close management tools (such as FloQast). Comfort with SQL, Python, or automation tools is a plus.
  • Hands-on and detail-oriented: You tie out numbers, spot what looks wrong, and follow it through to a fix.
  • Builder mindset: You are at ease setting up processes, templates, and controls from a blank page, and you do not wait for a playbook.
  • Can-do attitude: You take ownership, ask good questions, move quickly when deadlines are tight, and stay calm under pressure.
  • Communication: You can explain accounting and regulatory capital topics clearly to non-finance partners in Trading, Product, and Engineering.

lists.text: Although not a requirement, bonus points if
lists.content:
• Experience helping stand up or scale a finance function at a broker-dealer or swap dealer.
  • FCM accounting and reporting experience (CFTC Regulation 1.17, Form 1-FR-FCM, customer segregation), useful if an FCM is launched later.
  • Accounting or financial reporting experience with digital assets or crypto derivatives.
  • Familiarity with institutional trading systems, clearing platforms, and modern ledgering software.
  • Interest in the changing regulatory landscape for stablecoins, tokenized assets, and decentralized finance.
  • Prior Series 27 or NFA Series 3 exam progress.
